survivors.title: Lintel for maintenance teams
survivors.pitch: Work orders without the paperwork: the machine plate unlocks the exact manual page built for maintenance teams, ends in printed QR cards for the wall.

survivors.title: Spokeshave Pilot
survivors.pitch: Solar crews's busiest person stops making commissioning reports by hand — filmed tasks become step-by-step SOPs with checkpoints does it, every face and voice opt-in with deletion built in.

verdicts.attack: Voice-to-SOP workflow requires complex computer use integration beyond simple transcription
verdicts.why: Strong concrete use case with clear time savings, but technically ambitious for 8 days

verdicts.attack: QR cards for manuals is a simple solution to a complex problem
verdicts.why: Buildable, solves a real pain point, and creates a tangible artifact that's easy to demo

verdicts.attack: Farm counter cameras would need complex object tracking and inventory logic
verdicts.why: Interesting application but over-scoped for 8 days with uncertain demo value

verdicts.attack: Bookshop intake is too narrow a use case for the technical complexity
